items.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Salute, shelter, wander-not; grace conquers. [1] Alone supreme nectar-one ablaze, all-swallowed: venerated. [2] Three-undiffering endure by knowing-shape becoming. [3] Melted bliss-mass; principle likened in form venerated. [4] Script-outlines man; shape reveals varied You. [5] Entered concept-free; reflected never fancy-caught. [6] Light-goddess-flowers arranged; guru unfolded, heart entered. [7] Reflecting praise in body-temple, bonds outpoured. [8] Five-named conquer; splits gained, mouths called. [9] Limbs to Sadāśiva; corpse-self seat.

paragraphs.text: Bow down. Take shelter. Do not wander. Grace conquers — that is the whole door, and the song walks through it: salute, shelter, conquer.

Then whom it bows to, piece by piece. Alone, supreme, a nectar-one ablaze, everything swallowed: venerated. Praised, praiser, praise — three with no difference between them, enduring by becoming knowing-shaped. Melted bliss-mass; His principle likened in form, venerated. As a script outlines a man, so shape reveals the varied You. Entered concept-free, we reflect — and reflection is never caught by fancy. Light made, goddess worded, flowers laid: the guru unfolds, the heart gets entered. Praise mirrored in the body-temple, bonds poured out. Five-named powers conquer; splits gained, mouths called. Limbs to Sadashiva; corpse-self for a seat.

paragraphs.text: Her spread first: all goddesses, BrahmI-led, all of them. Then His gear, piece by piece, each verse one more thing He holds. Borne and pointed; opposed in the world, unopposed in me. Thread loosed, sapless knowers shown, garlanded as if skulls — shown as-if, mark that. Look, look: the doubled command, and gut-holding appears as if. Impassioned cloth cast up in heaven; bloodied hide told. Dagger bared, splitting the world-round; best are the heroes whose world is taken by own power and glory.

The slayer stands lorded; fear not — the shield points the way. Time noosed and counted; death of death shown. Hurled to unmake by His own power; the goad makes it plain. Drawn bow shown, BrahmA-ViSNu-Rudra lords arrayed with SadAkhya-Shivas; by power the cause-deer is pierced deer-like.

items.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Boon-hand glory-giving; unstained principle-fixed. [1] Fearlessness uproots; grace palmed. [2] Shattered Māyā-skull borne waking shown. [3] Taken rest in mass; pretext commands. [4] Played triple sound heard standing. [5] Triple-lovely imitated outside trident-held always. [6] Lower-three shown; thunderbolt six-spoked borne. [7] Tamed held; staff-revealed to us. [8] Borne bent splitting; pointed. [9] Assumed various, proclaimed, abode everywhere.

paragraphs.text: By the boon hand, glory-giving gets enacted, and the principle stays fixed and unstained. Fearlessness uproots the world-fears, and grace sits palmed and ready. Shattered MAyA-skull, borne while waking is shown. Essence wholly taken, rest in the mass: by skull-staff-bone pretext, the command goes out.

Lute, bell, drum — wild One, playing: this You show, and triple-split work-sound is heard by one standing. ParA-led triple-spoked power, lovely and great: gods You mirror outside, trident held always. Will-led powers shown in lower seats three; Your own supreme power, thunder-made, borne six-spoked. World entire by Your power tamed, all stations held: staff-revealed, Consciousness-Bhairava, to us.

Mace and axe borne, bindu-sound mirrored; bent on splitting split from unsplit, You point, O ISAna. By differing visions, Lord, shapes assumed and shed: waking-made Bhairava proclaimed, own abode everywhere.

Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if. [1] Crested uprooters lotus-shown held. [2] Seed-ground mirrored; pomegranate-played. [3] Rosary held turns world within by letters. [4] Gore-decked teaches Brahma-pure. [5] Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire. [6] Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states. [7] Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering. [8] Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground. [9] Form-worn shown; parted-freed sealed.

paragraphs.text: In the Powers egg-broken middle: world-saps, all of them, I drink always. Shown by skull-cup-blood pretext, this as-it-were my inside. Pride-heart-bond uprooters, those two, these crested embodied: lotus-skulls as it were, showing, held by You, great Time. All-worlds seed-ground, first station, mirrored: waking-treasure. By palm-pomegranate show-play, O god.

Bhairava-shaped though, rosary in hand held: so by every letter’s opening, turn the world within. Bone in hand, skulls garlanded, ash-smeared, man-blood-red: by Brahma-fullness the world is pure, so teaches the Lord. For self-pleased full ones, though sense-bubbles jar: what burns desire — brow-eye showing — they teach as supreme-fire-formed.

Inward tied-aimed, faculties spread, though You ever are: that shown in every state, delusion-stained-gone self. God — Your sky-cladness speaks the self bare: suns of supreme-Brahma-fullness — MAyA’s veil, how should it cover? All-destroyer, suns and the rest: I, dark ground, spotless autumn-sky gleaming-bodied, thus shown. Brahma-full supreme god, when wearing Bhairava-shape: that shown, principle-knower, being though parted, freed.

items.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Ghoul-girt measuring shown; Bhairava-am-I. [1] Nectar-knower life shining heartward. [2] Sound-bodied eightfold outer-led. [3] Sealed all delighted throng by fullness-shown. [4] Loosed-melted sealed wealth seal-called. [5] Conquering draught dwells clearly; stain known. [6] Momently rising below-flashing; glory-formed known. [7] In-me flashing sealed; rite complete effortless.

paragraphs.text: Girt with burning-ground garlands, ghouls around, measuring the sense-fields midst shown: Consciousness-Bhairava am I. In You alone, nectar-streak, supreme-power-made, last knower — hence Lord. You alone are worlds’ life: shine in our hearts. Yours, sound-mass-bodied, eightfold-warded, outer circle just; by finest splits and finer, Bhairava, world-lords-led.

It seals all this: total self-form given over, gladdening the devotee-throng, path-joyed, by showing full. Loosed noose-nets, melted marks: Your shape, Lord, seals knowing-wealth of every kind — seal so called. It conquers, supreme-ground-excellent, draught-become: clearly may it dwell, by truth-showing, heart’s known-stain.

Each moment rises knowing; there indeed it flashes below. Know it: the world as Shiva-power-glory-formed, Maheśa’s rite-standers. So in me You flash always — Consciousness-Bhairava, every being’s self — then rite to mantra’s end, complete, effortless, all.
